scope: Physical custody of thirteen plain items referenced by owned quest recipes; no equipment, fluid or custom use activation.

description.value: No one really knows where it leads to, but the dragon graveyard might reveal the secret - or not.
This strange creature has the tendency to set certain things on fire.
The blood is of a deep ruby red, yet smells poisonous.
It shimmers greenly and sparkles softly.
Dogs would probably find this treat really yummy.
The water in the ewer shimmers faintly. In the desert's heat it will evaporate soon, however.
You have the slight impression that it bears a secret.
The location on the map is not familiar to you.
